text:
jordan_sec: Heads-up — after yesterday's rbac-role-condense we started seeing deploys failing to pull GPU nodes. Controller logs show token signing errors + KMS decrypt 403s. Audit entries for the TokenRequest are missing principalEmail. Anyone else?

deploy-bot: [automated] failed deploy: controlplane/deploy-ml-worker retry=3 — TokenRequest denied

maria_infra: grabbing logs, can you paste the controller error line?

jordan_sec: here — `E0405 14:12:07 tokenrequest.go:142] failed to sign token: kms: decrypt access denied`

leo_infra: sounds like the controller's service account lost kms:decrypt permission on the KMS key or the RBAC change removed TokenRequest/Create on the controller. Quick check: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding | grep controller`

maria_infra: ran that — controller-manager-binding exists but the sa is now `system:serviceaccount:controllers:deploy-controller-sa` (new name). The keyring IAM still trusts `serviceAccount:old-controller@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

jess_security: probable IAM principal mismatch. Our RBAC refactor renamed SAs; KMS IAM bindings didn't get updated. We also see audit entries without the expected principalEmail — suggests the request is failing before IAM assertion or identity mapping is dropped.

leo_infra: mitigation: create a short-lived ClusterRoleBinding to allow tokenrequests: 
```
kubectl create clusterrolebinding rbac-deploy-tokenreq \
  --clusterrole=system:token-requestor \
  --user=system:serviceaccount:controllers:deploy-controller-sa
```
Will open access to sign tokens until we fix IAM.

maria_infra: created binding. Observability shows deploy retries dropping, nodes pulling images again. :thumbsup:

jordan_sec: thanks. Next steps: 1) update KMS IAM to include new SA 2) update audit pipeline to capture TokenRequest actor/principalEmail 3) run RBAC audit tooling across clusters to catch SA renames and drift.

jess_security: for audit query use: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=\"k8s_cluster\" AND protoPayload.methodName=\"io.k8s.core.v1.TokenRequest\"' --project=redwood-prod` — look for protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail and protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp

leo_infra: also adding a presubmit check to the infra codemod that renames serviceaccounts to update KMS/IAM bindings. I'll post the patch to infra-ops.

maria_infra: logging note — we saw 7 failed decrypts from 14:09-14:13 originating from the controller SA; exported logs to gs://redwood-ops/incident-1749991111/logs.tar.gz

jordan_sec: tagging compliance and support. Filing incident ticket with remediation steps. Will follow up with rollback window if IAM change can't be applied quickly.

deploy-bot: [automated] incident created: INC-2024-1749991111 by jordan_sec
